description: 1099 preparation, recipient delivery, and IRS IRIS A2A e-filing.
_doc: Imported from KisaesDevLab/Vibe-1099 appliance/manifest.yaml (Addendum A). Upstream ships no .appliance/manifest.json yet, so this in-tree copy is authoritative until it does (Phase 5 convention). ROOT-SERVED ONLY (flag set 2026-07-28, v0.1.0 images): vibe1099-web ships stock nginx entrypoints (no 40-base-path.sh) and its bundle asks for /assets/* at absolute root, so a /1099/ path mount serves a blank page — the env template warned about this since import; the flag is what enforces it. Root-served vhost at 1099.<domain> in BOTH domain routing modes; :5176 is the access path in LAN/Tailscale. Drop the flag if upstream adds base-path support (same condition as vibe-ai-router). SSO (Vibe-1099 PR #6, Phase 8 step 5): the api tier serves /auth/*; the back-channel logout arrives container-to-container at sso.internalUrl; the break-glass CLI runs inside vibe1099-app (VIBE_AUTH_ADAPTER is set by its Dockerfile). Mode/register/rotate live on the Identity panel; the per-app auth policy knobs below (MFA, JIT, default role, role map) are Tier-1 settings on the Apps tab. Mirror of Vibe-1099/.appliance/manifest.json.

required.name: VIBE1099_ADMIN_PASSWORD
required.doc: First-login password for the staff app, generated on enable and preserved across re-renders. Surfaced in the console's First-login card and /opt/vibe/CREDENTIALS.txt via firstLogin.passwordEnvKey. Applied by the seed (pnpm bootstrap:firm) — which needs a Vibe-1099 release containing upstream PR #5; on older images the seed fails soft and retries at the next enable.

optional.name: VIBE1099_ADMIN_EMAIL
optional.doc: Login for the staff app's first admin. Set BEFORE first enable if you want a real address — the bootstrap creates the admin once (state.apps.<slug>.seeded gates it); afterwards add users from inside the app instead.

ui.label: Admin email
ui.helpText: The email you sign in with at Vibe 1099. Set it before you enable the app — after that the first-run bootstrap has already created the admin and won't run again.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default ("1099"). Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress) when DOMAIN_ROUTING_MODE=subdomain-per-app; ignored in single-host mode. Single DNS label — lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> when routing is 'subdomain per app'. Blank = default ("1099"). Vibe 1099's web SPA is built for a root base, so it REQUIRES subdomain-per-app routing (single-host path-mounting 404s its assets). Saving re-renders routing and re-provisions the tunnel; the app briefly restarts.

optional.name: STAFF_IP_ALLOWLIST
optional.doc: Comma-separated IPs/CIDRs allowed to reach staff APIs. Belt-and-braces for the split-exposure model: staff endpoints refuse tunnel-origin traffic even if a route leaks. Empty = no IP restriction (rely on auth). See the app's docs/appliance-integration.md.

ui.label: Staff API IP allowlist
ui.helpText: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.7). Staff APIs reject any source not on this list — recommended when the recipient portal is public via the tunnel so a leaked staff route still can't be reached from the internet. Leave blank to disable IP gating.

optional.name: TAXBANDITS_ENABLED
optional.doc: Enable the TaxBandits e-file provider path (1099 batch e-filing). Requires provider credentials; leave 0 until the firm is onboarded (TCC/ATS).

ui.label: TaxBandits e-file
ui.helpText: Turn on to route 1099 e-filing through TaxBandits. Requires firm onboarding + provider credentials (see the app's docs/firm-onboarding.md). Default off.

optional.name: VIBE_OIDC_REQUIRE_MFA_AMR
optional.doc: Refuse a single sign-on login whose ID token carries no MFA `amr` claim. An SSO session bypasses the app's own TOTP, so the identity provider's MFA stands in; keep this on unless the firm has deliberately not enrolled staff in MFA at Vibe Auth. Operator-owned: registration never writes it, Disable SSO never strips it, and a re-render keeps the value set here (Tier-1 keys win over the template default). It survives Register / Fix / rebase / Disable / re-enable.

ui.label: SSO requires MFA at the identity provider
ui.helpText: On: a Vibe Auth sign-in is accepted only when the identity provider reports multi-factor authentication. Off: password-only SSO logins are accepted. Local (password) sign-in to Vibe 1099 is unaffected and keeps its own TOTP.

optional.name: VIBE_OIDC_ALLOW_JIT
optional.doc: Just-in-time provisioning: create a Vibe 1099 staff user on first SSO sign-in (role from the Vibe group map, joins the firm). Off = only users already present in Vibe 1099 (matched by verified email) can sign in with SSO.

ui.label: Create staff accounts on first SSO sign-in
ui.helpText: On: anyone the identity provider admits gets a Vibe 1099 account automatically, with the role mapped from their Vibe group. Off: staff must be added in Vibe 1099 (Settings → Users) with the same email before SSO lets them in.

optional.name: VIBE_OIDC_DEFAULT_ROLE
optional.doc: Role for an SSO user whose Vibe groups map to nothing. Empty = no role → the login is refused (safest). Vibe 1099 roles: admin, reviewer, preparer.

ui.label: SSO fallback role
ui.helpText: Applied when a signed-in user is in none of the mapped Vibe groups. "None" refuses such logins — recommended.

optional.name: VIBE_OIDC_ROLE_MAP
optional.doc: JSON object, Vibe group → Vibe 1099 role. Empty = the app's default: vibe-admin / vibe-it / vibe-partner → admin, vibe-manager → reviewer, vibe-staff → preparer. A value saved on the app's own Settings → Authentication page overrides this.

ui.label: SSO group → role map (JSON)
ui.helpText: Example: {"vibe-partner":"admin","vibe-manager":"reviewer","vibe-staff":"preparer"}. Leave blank for the built-in map. Roles: admin, reviewer, preparer.

firstLogin.note: The username is whatever VIBE1099_ADMIN_EMAIL was at enable time. Created by the production bootstrap (pnpm bootstrap:firm) — NOT the demo seed, which injects demo data and must never run in production. Requires a Vibe-1099 release containing upstream PR #5; on older images the seed fails soft (warning in the enable log), no login exists yet, and the next enable retries it. Change the password inside the app after first sign-in; the appliance won't reset it (the bootstrap runs once). Firm onboarding (TCC/ATS, EIN, address): the app's docs/firm-onboarding.md.

seed.description: Production first-run bootstrap: creates the real firm (FIRM_NAME) and the admin login (VIBE1099_ADMIN_EMAIL / VIBE1099_ADMIN_PASSWORD). No demo data — this is NOT `pnpm seed`. Idempotent; re-running only re-applies the admin password. Runs in the vibe1099-app container (the api matcher's upstream). Needs a release containing KisaesDevLab/Vibe-1099 PR #5; on older images pnpm exits non-zero (missing script) and enable-app logs a warning without failing the enable.
